主要内容: Dan Gertler, an Israeli billionaire, has amassed significant wealth through his investments in mining and other sectors in the Democratic Republic of Congo. His journey began in 1997 when he arrived in the country seeking rough diamonds. Over the years, Gertler has expanded his portfolio to include iron ore, gold, cobalt, and copper, as well as agriculture, oil, and banking. His latest project, the Musonoie-T17 copper and cobalt mine operated by Katanga Mining Ltd., is a massive installation twice the size of Monaco. This mine transforms ore mined from the ochre earth into sheets of copper, showcasing Gertler's continued success in the mining industry despite the country's status as one of the poorest in the world.
